scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter mathml2omml run build && pnpm --filter pptxgenjs exec tsc
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:backend & pnpm run dev:classroom
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm run build:packages && cd apps/backend && python3.12 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test:backend: cd apps/backend && source venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=. pytest
